verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM has an AI agent layer (Zia, Agent Studio), so it is fair to ask whether it can consume external MCP servers. The evidence only documents Zoho's own official MCP server, which exposes CRM tools to external clients like Cursor and Claude. That server role does not count toward this client-side story, and nothing shows Zia or Agent Studio connecting to third-party MCP servers.
